# The Guardian

> Latest international news, sport, opinion, culture, lifestyle, and live coverage from the Guardian.

The Guardian is a global news publisher covering breaking news, investigations, politics, business, climate, sport, culture, and lifestyle across UK, US, Australia, and international editions.

## Home & Editions
- [The Guardian Home](https://www.theguardian.com): Main homepage with the latest headlines, live blogs, analysis, and featured reporting.
- [US News](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news): US-focused news hub covering politics, society, courts, and breaking stories.
- [UK News](https://www.theguardian.com/uk-news): UK-focused reporting on politics, public services, crime, and national affairs.
- [Australia News](https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news): Australian news coverage including politics, environment, and public interest reporting.
- [Europe News](https://www.theguardian.com/world/europe-news): European news, politics, diplomacy, and regional developments.
- [World News](https://www.theguardian.com/world): Global news coverage spanning regions, conflicts, diplomacy, and international affairs.

## News & Politics
- [Politics](https://www.theguardian.com/politics): UK politics news, policy coverage, Westminster reporting, and political analysis.
- [US Politics](https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/us-politics): US political reporting on elections, Congress, the presidency, and policy debates.
- [Global Development](https://www.theguardian.com/global-development): Reporting on inequality, aid, public health, and development worldwide.
- [Media](https://www.theguardian.com/media): News and analysis on journalism, broadcasting, platforms, and the media industry.
- [Law](https://www.theguardian.com/law): Legal news, courts coverage, justice issues, and major case reporting.
- [Education](https://www.theguardian.com/education): Schools, universities, policy, and education sector reporting.

## World Regions
- [Africa](https://www.theguardian.com/world/africa): News and features from across Africa, including politics, conflict, and society.
- [Asia Pacific](https://www.theguardian.com/world/asia-pacific): Coverage of East Asia, South Asia, Oceania, and regional affairs.
- [Europe](https://www.theguardian.com/world/europe): Continental Europe news, politics, elections, and diplomacy.
- [Middle East](https://www.theguardian.com/world/middleeast): Reporting on Middle East politics, conflict, diplomacy, and society.
- [Americas](https://www.theguardian.com/world/americas): News from North America, Latin America, and regional developments.
- [Australia](https://www.theguardian.com/australia-news): National reporting and analysis from Guardian Australia.

## Business, Tech & Science
- [Business](https://www.theguardian.com/business): Markets, companies, economics, consumer affairs, and financial news.
- [Technology](https://www.theguardian.com/uk/technology): Technology news covering AI, platforms, devices, privacy, and digital policy.
- [Science](https://www.theguardian.com/science): Scientific discoveries, research news, space, health science, and expert analysis.
- [Environment](https://www.theguardian.com/environment): Environmental reporting on biodiversity, pollution, conservation, and policy.
- [Climate Crisis](https://www.theguardian.com/environment/climate-crisis): Dedicated climate coverage on emissions, impacts, adaptation, and politics.
- [Cities](https://www.theguardian.com/cities): Urban policy, housing, transport, planning, and city life reporting.
- [Money](https://www.theguardian.com/money): Personal finance, consumer rights, savings, pensions, and household economics.

## Opinion & Editorial
- [Opinion](https://www.theguardian.com/tone/opinion): Opinion pieces, editorials, columns, and commentary across major issues.
- [Comment is Free](https://www.theguardian.com/commentisfree): Guardian opinion hub featuring columnists, essays, and debate.
- [Editorials](https://www.theguardian.com/tone/editorials): Official Guardian editorial positions on politics, society, and world affairs.
- [Cartoons](https://www.theguardian.com/cartoons/archive): Political cartoons and illustrated commentary from Guardian contributors.
- [Letters](https://www.theguardian.com/tone/letters): Reader letters responding to current events, reporting, and opinion pieces.

## Sport
- [Sport](https://www.theguardian.com/sport): Main sport hub with live scores, match reports, analysis, and commentary.
- [Football](https://www.theguardian.com/football): Football news, Premier League coverage, transfers, and match analysis.
- [Cricket](https://www.theguardian.com/sport/cricket): Cricket news, international series coverage, and commentary.
- [Tennis](https://www.theguardian.com/sport/tennis): Tennis reporting from grand slams, tours, and major tournaments.
- [Rugby Union](https://www.theguardian.com/sport/rugby-union): Rugby union news, fixtures, analysis, and tournament coverage.
- [Formula One](https://www.theguardian.com/sport/formulaone): Formula One race coverage, driver news, and technical analysis.
- [Cycling](https://www.theguardian.com/sport/cycling): Professional cycling races, riders, and event coverage.
- [Golf](https://www.theguardian.com/sport/golf): Golf majors, tours, player news, and tournament reporting.

## Culture & Entertainment
- [Culture](https://www.theguardian.com/culture): Arts and entertainment coverage across film, TV, music, books, and stage.
- [Film](https://www.theguardian.com/film): Film news, reviews, interviews, festival coverage, and criticism.
- [Television & Radio](https://www.theguardian.com/tv-and-radio): TV and radio reviews, interviews, recaps, and industry coverage.
- [Music](https://www.theguardian.com/music): Music news, album reviews, interviews, and live performance coverage.
- [Books](https://www.theguardian.com/books): Book reviews, author interviews, literary news, and reading features.
- [Stage](https://www.theguardian.com/stage): Theatre, dance, opera, and live performance reviews and features.
- [Art and Design](https://www.theguardian.com/artanddesign): Visual arts, architecture, photography, and design coverage.
- [Games](https://www.theguardian.com/games): Video game news, reviews, criticism, and industry reporting.

## Lifestyle & Wellbeing
- [Life and Style](https://www.theguardian.com/lifeandstyle): Lifestyle coverage including relationships, food, health, and personal stories.
- [Food](https://www.theguardian.com/food): Recipes, restaurant writing, cooking advice, and food culture reporting.
- [Fashion](https://www.theguardian.com/fashion): Fashion news, runway coverage, style features, and industry analysis.
- [Travel](https://www.theguardian.com/travel): Travel inspiration, destination guides, practical advice, and reader tips.
- [Health & Wellbeing](https://www.theguardian.com/lifeandstyle/health-and-wellbeing): Health reporting, fitness, mental wellbeing, and medical advice features.
- [Relationships](https://www.theguardian.com/lifeandstyle/relationships): Advice, essays, and reporting on family, dating, and partnerships.
- [Women](https://www.theguardian.com/lifeandstyle/women): Reporting and features on gender, equality, work, and everyday life.
- [Men](https://www.theguardian.com/lifeandstyle/men): Features and commentary on masculinity, health, style, and culture.

## Society & Special Coverage
- [Society](https://www.theguardian.com/society): Social policy, welfare, public services, charities, and civil society reporting.
- [Inequality](https://www.theguardian.com/inequality): Coverage of wealth gaps, poverty, labor, and social justice.
- [Housing Network](https://www.theguardian.com/housing-network): Housing policy, homelessness, planning, and social housing coverage.
- [Public Leaders Network](https://www.theguardian.com/public-leaders-network): Public sector leadership, policy implementation, and service delivery analysis.
- [Voluntary Sector Network](https://www.theguardian.com/voluntary-sector-network): Charity sector news, fundraising, governance, and nonprofit issues.
- [Social Care Network](https://www.theguardian.com/social-care-network): Adult social care policy, workforce issues, and service reform coverage.

## Multimedia & Interactive
- [Live](https://www.theguardian.com/tone/live): Live blogs and rolling coverage of breaking news, politics, and sport.
- [Video](https://www.theguardian.com/video): News videos, interviews, explainers, documentaries, and visual reporting.
- [Podcasts](https://www.theguardian.com/podcasts): Guardian podcast directory covering news, politics, culture, and sport.
- [Pictures](https://www.theguardian.com/news/series/eyewitness): Photo-led storytelling and visual journalism from around the world.
- [Documentaries](https://www.theguardian.com/tone/documentary): Documentary films and longer-form visual reporting.
- [Interactive](https://www.theguardian.com/tone/interactive): Interactive graphics, data stories, and immersive visual explainers.

## Search & Topics
- [Search](https://www.theguardian.com/search): Site search for articles, topics, contributors, and archived coverage.
- [News](https://www.theguardian.com/news): Broad news index spanning major reporting areas and current coverage.
- [Series](https://www.theguardian.com/news/series): Editorial series and recurring coverage collections.
- [Topics A-Z](https://www.theguardian.com/index/subjects/a): Alphabetical index of subjects, beats, and recurring topics.
- [Contributors](https://www.theguardian.com/profile): Directory of Guardian journalists, columnists, and contributors.
- [Archive Search](https://www.theguardian.com/theguardian): Entry point to Guardian newspaper and historical publication content.
